plugins.name: shop
plugins.description: Run your Shop Bot store in plain language: sales reports and what needs attention, catalog, price and membership plan changes, coupons, licence-key imports, support replies and download restores, review moderation and custom-order requests, through the store's own MCP server with your API token. Destructive changes take a confirmed second call, and big ones wait for the owner's Approve in Telegram.
